// Command capguest is a tool that exercises every capability host function.
//
// It exists to be compiled to wasip1 by the test and run for real, because
// the SDK's guest-side ABI -- the size-then-fetch round trip, the envelope
// decode, the denial type -- has no other honest test. A mock host would
// re-implement the thing under test.
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"strings"

	"github.com/richardwooding/forge/sdk/tool"
)

type Args struct {
	Do  string `json:"do"`
	Arg string `json:"arg,omitempty"`
}

type Out struct {
	Result string `json:"result"`
	Denied bool   `json:"denied,omitempty"`
	Code   string `json:"code,omitempty"`
}

var _ = tool.Register(tool.Spec{
	Name:    "capguest",
	Summary: "exercises the capability host functions",
	Needs: []tool.Need{
		{Kind: tool.NetHTTP, Scope: []string{"*"}, Reason: "the test drives it"},
		{Kind: tool.KV, Scope: []string{"notes"}, Reason: "the test drives it"},
		{Kind: tool.Secret, Scope: []string{"token"}, Reason: "the test drives it"},
	},
}, tool.Op("run", run))

func main() {}

func run(ctx *tool.Context, a Args) (Out, error) {
	switch a.Do {
	case "http":
		res, err := tool.Get(a.Arg)
		if err != nil {
			return denied(err)
		}
		return Out{Result: fmt.Sprintf("%d:%s", res.Status, strings.TrimSpace(string(res.Body)))}, nil

	case "http-headers":
		_, err := tool.HTTP(tool.HTTPRequest{
			URL:     a.Arg,
			Headers: map[string]string{"Authorization": "Bearer hunter2"},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return denied(err)
		}
		return Out{Result: "the header was accepted"}, nil

	case "kv":
		s := tool.OpenKV("notes")
		if err := s.SetString("greeting", "hello"); err != nil {
			return denied(err)
		}
		v, found, err := s.GetString("greeting")
		if err != nil {
			return denied(err)
		}
		keys, err := s.List("")
		if err != nil {
			return denied(err)
		}
		return Out{Result: fmt.Sprintf("%s/%v/%v", v, found, keys)}, nil

	case "kv-forbidden":
		if _, _, err := tool.OpenKV("other").Get("x"); err != nil {
			return denied(err)
		}
		return Out{Result: "read an ungranted namespace"}, nil

	case "secret":
		v, found, err := tool.GetSecret(a.Arg)
		if err != nil {
			return denied(err)
		}
		return Out{Result: fmt.Sprintf("%s/%v", v, found)}, nil

	case "invoke":
		var out map[string]any
		if err := tool.Call(a.Arg, "run", map[string]string{"do": "kv"}, &out); err != nil {
			return denied(err)
		}
		return Out{Result: fmt.Sprint(out)}, nil
	}
	return Out{}, fmt.Errorf("capguest does not know how to %q", a.Do)
}

// denied reports a capability refusal as data rather than an error, so the
// test can tell a denial apart from a tool that simply broke.
func denied(err error) (Out, error) {
	if d, ok := tool.Denied(err); ok {
		return Out{Result: d.Error(), Denied: true, Code: d.Code}, nil
	}
	return Out{Result: err.Error()}, nil
}
